newsitem.title: USA: Japanese girl awaiting transplant has heart attack.
newsitem.headline: Japanese girl awaiting transplant has heart attack.

text.p: An eight-year-old Japanese girl awaiting a heart transplant has suffered a heart attack and is "very, very sick," a hospital spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Ruthie Marek, spokeswoman for the University of California Los Angeles Medical Centre, said Miyuki Monobe was on a heart-lung machine in critical condition following the heart attack on Wednesday.

The girl, who was born with a hole in her heart, came to the United States last Saturday in the hope of getting a new heart. Such transplants are very rare in Japan because of that country's organ donor laws.
Doctors at the hospital earlier this week declared the young girl a suitable heart transplant recipient and she was placed on the United Network for Organ Sharing transplant list.
Marek said the girl remains on the list but as of Thursday a matching donor heart had not been found.
